svg.title: Fishmonger — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as fishmonger, wearing an apron and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A fish with a triangular tail rests above the pan and round dial of a compact weighing scale. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
